title: Method Flow causal-incident graph, counterfactual workaround, and retry-quarantine ledger
hypothesis: An append-only incident graph can preserve each operational negative, distinguish observed causes from hypotheses, test a bounded counterfactual workaround, and quarantine repeated retries without treating recovery as independent evidence.
rollback: Return the method to observed or candidate, retain every event and failed witness, quarantine the signature, and require a new precondition before retry.
boundary: Software and synthetic fixtures can establish only bounded structural behavior. They do not establish empirical GMUT confirmation, THOS effectiveness, production identity assurance, legal or cultural authority, independent reproduction, AGI/ASI, complete accessibility, exhaustive security, or Stage 20 readiness.
